impact_assessment.why: The report's P0 items are the highest-value gaps: no decaying error pressure, no conversation-level injection/leak screen, and changes unrelated to a goal.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recoverable risk state, predictable prompt-injection defence in observe/enforce modes, and purposeful self-modification with a revalidated link.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new optional API fields and a stricter default operator path; dependency: none beyond stdlib; concurrency: kernel windows under the existing ledger lock; state: additive JSON fields plus an optional goal_id in change ledgers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Defaults preserve old behaviour for direct engine use, the guardrail default is observe, and every behaviour has a failing-first test.

impact_assessment.why: The P1 items from the Tif report: unbounded aggregate spend and no dry structural analysis before a run or promotion.
impact_assessment.benefits: Predictable cost ceilings with precise failures, and a stable pre-flight report shared by the editor and the improvement gate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a very large flow can now be blocked by its budget; dependency: none; concurrency: contextvar per task, no shared mutable state; state: candidates gain a simulation object.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Defaults are generous, flow metadata can only lower a limit, and one-pass versus cycle findings are separated so ordinary loops are not blocked.

[1/4] Failure consolidation into bounded avoidance knowledge (ADR-047). [2/4] Agent-loop repetition guard with warning then abort (ADR-045). [3/4] Unified daily self-modification budget across improvement, configuration and learning (ADR-046). [4/4] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The remaining P2 control items from the Tif report: repeated failures were never distilled, looping agents only stopped at the iteration cap, and learning writes were unbounded across subsystems.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recurring failures become reviewable advice, loops fail fast with a trace reason, and one operator-visible ceiling bounds self-modification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: agent loop now returns a fifth value and spend() may stop a run; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: each budget/window uses its own ledger lock; state: additive learning-avoidance and budget ledgers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Avoidances are advisory, the guard warns once before aborting, and budget reservations are released on failure.
